# C32 — Archetype

## #0

The image appears with a force its visible content cannot contain. It gathers associations, redistributes feeling and draws a life along paths no single interpretation commands. **Archetype** names the generative organisation made legible through such variable manifestations; the archetype as such does not appear as a final content-object beside them. [[A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos]] supplies the wider field of possible differentiation, while C32 retains this specifically psychic and symbolic office.

## #1

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md|Symbolon Dynamics]] begins with a dream, god, number, symptom, fantasy, narrative, concept or bodily intensity as a possible archetypal manifestation. The particular image gives an unknown ordering relation a local face. Its excess over a settled interpretation keeps that face open to further manifestation. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|Image / Valuation]] owns the determinate image and its investment; it must not be substituted for the generative organisation.

The broken symbolon's seam makes the relation tangible. One half carries the shape of a counterpart it cannot manufacture alone; recognition depends on their relation. An image can similarly make its absent or unexhausted condition operative. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|Living Symbol / Idol]] marks the difference between an image that keeps this relation active and one installed as the exhaustive identity of its source.

## #2

The native QL relation is read first. `0/1` retains unrepresentable ground and representable mark through their relating stroke; `X/x` differentiates determining capacity from its indefinite particular. Archetypal recurrence is Taylor's psychic instantiation of this already derived relation. Across distinct images, the determining capacity becomes legible without becoming another image. The notation is authorial QL, not Jung's.

The whole traversal under [[A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations|the eight determinations]] prevents pattern from being isolated from its life: appearance questions, attracts and repels, gathers into recurrence, stakes a first-person relation and effects a particular transformation before returning toward its source. This is the author's cross-register movement. It does not make the sequence a historical Jungian derivation or reduce symbolic experience to six labels.

## #3

An attractor and a trajectory articulate different aspects of the dynamic comparison. A trajectory is an actual history through a state-space; the attractor organises recurrent behaviour that no single orbit exhausts. In the authorial psychic reading, what persists can be the organisation of transformation itself. Historical novelty therefore does not have to be the abandonment of every recurrent form.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C31-Complex|Complexes]] stabilise local affective organisations; symbols can intensify them, expose their boundaries, connect separated regions or enable a new regime. The full [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md|Van Eenwyk encounter]] supplies the developmental dynamic middle. A recurrent image is not automatically a strange attractor, and the technical definitions of attractor, basin and bifurcation retain their mathematical requirements.

## #4

Amplification and transformation do different work. Amplification moves among manifestations so that one partial view becomes readable through another; transformation changes the lived trajectory and its possibilities. [[A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas|World-atlas]] gives the first operation a chart comparison, while the basin/trajectory account gives the second a dynamic comparison. An atlas is not an attractor. A shared motif alone establishes neither a transition map nor a common causal mechanism.

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Homology and Analogy field]] requires a cross-cultural comparison to preserve the whole relation in each carrier: who acts, what changes, what returns and what the image cannot settle. The myth's historical transmission and the operation it performs remain different questions. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number|Psychoid Number]] asks the further psyche/physis question; it does not answer it merely by showing that a number occurs in both domains.

## #5→0

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **qualifies** the difference between a particular maternal image and determining capacity. The encountered body, cope and corrected reading give that capacity a situated manifestation. Neumann’s morphology provides shared archetypal structuration while the local encounter retains its own history and cannot become a universal template.

The Neumann whole articulates shared genesis through changing parental, bodily and heroic offices. Situated tellings and their temporal transformations remain distinct from this common archetypal articulation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round). The round, nurturing body, world-parent relation and transformed centre retain different archetypal offices within the shared field. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants).

An archetypal interpretation returns to the life it has interpreted. [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|Image and valuation]] asks what its image makes available or excludes; [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|individuation]] asks how the relation among agencies changes. The outcome is not a completed catalogue of the archetype. A life recognises its own achieved differentiation within a wider ordering relation and becomes capable of another encounter.

[[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|Cultural sensitivity to origins]] extends this return without enthroning a collective ego or appointing one culture's image as the universal form. C32 owns pattern-through-variable-manifestation; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture|Symbolon disclosure]] keeps its historical, psychic, formal and mythic warrants accessible in their respective homes.

**Provenance and debt:** direct Symbolon Dynamics, the A16/A19/A21 packets, Van Eenwyk's full SOURCE/protected NOTES and [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md|Jung’s Aion source house]] carry this restoration. Jung's evolving definitions and exact psychoid/archetype passages still require selected locators; no copied notebook wording is promoted to a verified quotation. Cross-cultural universality and measured psychodynamic equations are not supplied by the present operational refraction.

**Depth Restoration:** canonical archetype/image/dynamic distinction restored; exact historical and comparative evidence remains source-specific.
